description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to setting and retrieving diagnostics and status information for MTA lines. It interacts with device configuration via getStr and setStr functions, and outputs JSON responses based on POST parameters. The file includes logic for checking user login state, starting diagnostics, and fetching status data for lines.
